blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Raffy Tulfo on Monday floated the idea of requiring the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) to include the date of birth of parents in certificates of live birth with the hopes of preventing fraudulent birth registrations and identity manipulation. Tulfo made the proposal during the Senate finance committee’s budget deliberations on the proposed 2027 spending plan of the Department of Economy, Planning and Development (DepDev).
